description: This file contains pytest-based test functions for verifying the functionality of the 'BedrockModelInfo' class in the context of 'Writer Palmyra' models within the 'Bedrock' lexicon. The tests check model routing to 'converse', handling cross-region model names, and extracting base model names from different model identifiers.

classes.name: BedrockModelInfo
classes.description: A class providing utilities for interpreting Bedrock model identifiers, such as determining routing and extracting base models.

methods.name: test_writer_palmyra_routes_to_converse()
methods.description: Verifies that specific Writer Palmyra models route to the 'converse' API.

methods.name: test_writer_palmyra_cross_region_routes_to_converse()
methods.description: Ensures cross-region prefixed models correctly route to 'converse'.

methods.name: test_writer_palmyra_base_model_extraction()
methods.description: Checks correct extraction of base model identifiers from cross-region models.
